scope: Read-only diagnosis of the reproduced App Store purchase failure; local diagnostic instrumentation only
observations: User reproduced the red purchase error while a live StoreKit capture was running.
StoreKit used its testflight transaction cache for this application.
The currentEntitlements query for com.skillomate.premium.monthly returned zero transactions.
The unfinished transaction query returned ten transactions across the application; the capture does not establish that all ten belong to this product.
StoreKit logged: Found unfinished transaction for com.skillomate.premium.monthly.
The same sequence occurred on repeated attempts.
interpretation: An unfinished subscription transaction is a confirmed recovery issue to investigate. A repeated purchase callback may be surfaced as duplicate-purchase by react-native-iap 14.7.20 and mapped to the app's generic purchase error. The original callback code was not captured, so this explanation remains an inference.
notEstablished: The original purchaseError.code and purchaseError.message from installed build 31.
Why the existing transaction was left unfinished, including whether verification, ownership or transaction finishing failed.
Whether the exact failure is duplicate-purchase, another library error, or a StoreKit error.
limitations: Installed release logging did not expose the original purchase callback details.
Debugger attachment to the installed app was denied by iOS.
Historical device log collection through Apple's log tool requires administrator authentication; live capture was obtained using an isolated temporary log reader instead.
Local diagnostic changes were not built, installed, deployed or published.
nextEvidence: Run the instrumented Apple subscription hook on the affected iPhone and reproduce once to record the sanitized native error code, message and any underlying error.
